look: Hollow Acolyte, a D-rank GKOM variant from the Whisperers family (GKOM-A cultists (Weaververse "Whisperers"), D&D cult fanatics archetype reimagined for Adams Haven): robed initiate cultist with black-veined hands and a hood. Family anatomy: hooded human GKOM-A cultists with black-veined hands, cracked-marble skin and red-tinged energy. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystals crust its joints and run along the spine; about a quarter of the body crystallised; the crystals are crimson crystal. A tennis-ball-sized GKOM core orb, dark amber with visible cracks, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Dark: violet, black and magenta accents, modest shadow smoke, star specks and dark sigils
